name: Pepper

schedule.notes: Bottom-heat 80 to 85 F. Slow to germinate; soak seeds 8 hours first.
Wait until soil is 65+ F and nights are reliably above 55 F.

harvest.cues: Pick green for crunch; leave on the plant to color and sweeten. Snip with shears — stems are brittle.
harvest.storageNotes: Fridge crisper 1 to 2 weeks. Freeze diced, no blanch needed.

varieties.name: Jalapeño
varieties.notes: Prolific. Heat increases with stress and ripeness.

varieties.name: California Wonder
varieties.notes: Classic four-lobed bell. Lets red sweeten if you can wait.

varieties.name: Shishito
varieties.notes: Pick at 2 to 3 inches. About 1 in 10 surprises you with heat.

notes: Cage or stake — bushes are brittle and snap under fruit load. Mulch heavily once soil is warm.
